source.method: Focused Playwright checks against canonical Production after PR #15 deployment

limitations: This is a reduced operator record of two targeted production tests, not a retained standalone Playwright report or whole-site visual acceptance artifact.

The reviewer-entry test asserts the two exact locale-specific entry hrefs, zero direct prototype-route anchors, and zero rendered /flash-assets/ sources. It does not inspect every possible runtime, asset, or credential-shaped string.
The Spanish terms check resolves the PR #13 clipping exception at the two named viewport widths only.
This record does not grant public demo rights or establish strict Flash migration fidelity.
